_metadata.collection_method: read-only GitHub CLI and GraphQL API queries
_metadata.sampling_limits: merge_group runs limited to 100 most recent; merged PRs limited to 50 most recent

queue_configuration_readback.command: gh api graphql -f query='{repository(owner:"alfloop-dev",name:"odayplus"){mergeQueue(branch:"dev"){id configuration{mergeMethod mergingStrategy checkResponseTimeout maximumEntriesToBuild maximumEntriesToMerge minimumEntriesToMerge minimumEntriesToMergeWaitTime}}}}'

local_policy_readback.note: Local policy.json values match remote readback for all merge_queue fields

ci_duration_minutes.note: Computed from runs with duration >1 min (excludes review-gate-only stamps)

concurrency_observations.note: 4 runs in the same minute corresponds to 2 unique merge-group SHAs × 2 workflow triggers each (ci.yml + merge-queue-review-gate.yml). This indicates max observed queue depth of 2 PRs processed concurrently.

merge_throughput_analysis.source: gh pr list --repo alfloop-dev/odayplus --base dev --state merged --limit 50
merge_throughput_analysis.note: Rate of 0.47 merges/hour across a 4.4-day sample. Runbook states ~1.5 merges/hour; this sample spans a weekend period which may undercount active-hours throughput. Median gap of 50 min between consecutive merges.

open_pr_snapshot.source: gh pr list --repo alfloop-dev/odayplus --base dev --state open

pr_summary.status: all checks passed except task-review-gate FAILURE

open_pr_snapshot.note: 4 open PRs, 2 with passing checks, 2 with failures. None currently in the merge queue based on age and status.

queue_depth_assessment.deep_queue_frequency: Rare; only 3 minutes in 4.1-day sample had >2 concurrent workflow runs
queue_depth_assessment.assessment: Queue depth is consistently low. The runbook observation that queue is 'rarely deeper than 2' is confirmed by this sample. With min_entries_to_merge=1, batching has no effect at current throughput.
